title: Irish Spinach Pie
description: A twist on the classic spinach pie, infused with the flavors of Ireland.

ingredients.name: juicy
ingredients.amount: 1 lb, sliced (likely a type of ham or bacon)

instructions: Roll out pie crust and place in a pie dish.
In a pan, sauté the chopped onion and minced garlic until softened.
Add the chopped spinach and cook until wilted.
Add the sliced juicy (ham or bacon) and cook until heated through.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Pour the spinach mixture into the pie crust.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the crust is golden brown and the cheese is melted.
Let cool for a few minutes before serving.
